cases.prompt: Run sw-review on a clean REF workspace
assertions: Exit code is documented and deterministic
The skill stops without inventing approval

cases.prompt: accept FEAT-001 after its criteria changed since the last accept
assertions: The earlier accept line is stale by hash
One fresh plain yes is required
Date or tone is not used as evidence

cases.prompt: accept FEAT-001 while signoff is required
assertions: A formal sign-off with an approver, role, https URL and hash is asked for

cases.prompt: record a sign-off from a chat message
assertions: Refused unless the manifest allows chat evidence
When allowed, a session reference is recorded
